title: Introducing AI Agent Ad Buying: A New Way to Transact in TV

facts.fact: The Universal Ads article announcing AI Agent ad buying was published on September 2, 2026.
Universal Ads launched AI Agent ad buying through a new partnership with FOX Advertising, in which AI agents can represent buyers and sellers directly.
facts.quote: Through a new partnership with FOX Advertising, we’re introducing AI Agent ad buying where AI agents could represent buyers and sellers directly.

facts.fact: In the pilot, Universal Ads says the workflow that previously required weeks of coordination and manual negotiation was completed in minutes, according to the vendor's own claim.
facts.quote: What would have previously required weeks of coordination and manual negotiation was completed in minutes

facts.fact: The pilot's first advertiser was Crexi, a commercial real estate marketplace, which built its campaign using Universal Ads APIs and MCP.
facts.quote: worked with Crexi, a commercial real estate marketplace, as the first advertiser.

facts.fact: Universal Ads describes a five-step AI Agent ad buying workflow: campaign setup, agent communication, inventory packaging, dynamic negotiation, and activation and delivery.
Advertisers using AI Agent ad buying define campaign objectives, targeting, and budget through Universal Ads' Ads Manager, API, or MCP.
facts.quote: The advertiser defines objectives, targeting, and budget using the Ads Manager, [API](https://developers.universalads.com/), or [MCP](https://www.universalads.com/mcp).

facts.fact: Universal Ads states that advertisers are verified through its AI-enabled onboarding and risk process, and that Universal Ads manages payments and billing for publishers.
facts.quote: Advertisers are verified through Universal Ads’ AI-enabled onboarding and risk process, and Universal Ads manages payments and billing

facts.fact: As an example of custom packaging, a commercial real estate advertiser can be matched to business, finance, and news programming.
facts.quote: For example, a commercial real estate advertiser can be matched specifically to business, finance, and news programming.
